nima: Quick note from today's pegasus9b-int8 bring-up. Strong unit-econ wins, but a split on multi-turn code-assist fidelity.
ara: numbers pls.
nima: p50 gen 118ms -> 94ms, p95 roughly flat, cost/1M tokens $112 -> $78. Code-assist pass-rate (our 2-step correctness) dropped 5.1pp (from 70.0 -> 64.9) on a 3k sample.
jon: Oof. Any human spot checks or hallucination signal?
nima: 250 human spots: acceptable answers 72% -> 65%, hallucinations up 2 -> 8 samples. Embedding-sim mean -0.009.
rita: Thats product-impacting for code-assist. Mitigations?
nima: Short list: 1) confidence-gate (cheap classifier) to route high-risk queries to fp16; 2) selective-perf: keep final MLP in fp16; 3) int6 micro-sweep if runtime supports.
ara: Love the confidence-gate idea. Define high-risk?
jon: Propose: endpoint tag X-LLM-PRESET=code-assist OR tokens > 1200 OR changeset requires multi-step exec.
rita: Unit econ calc? Need blended cost and CPA (cost-per-acceptable-answer) framing for GTN.
nima: Quick sketch: assume 180k daily queries avg 1.0k tokens. fp16 baseline ~$20.16k/day, full-int8 ~$14.04k/day. If we gate 18% to fp16 and 82% int8, blended ~$16.43k/day (~18.5% savings). Weighted pass-rate loss ~0.92pp if gate catches most high-risk. CPA: fp16 ~$0.0018, int8 ~$0.0012, blended ~$0.0015.
ara: Good. Recommend canary: 5% int8-only -> then enable gate at 18% with monitoring. Set alerts: code-pass-drop >1.5pp OR hallucination_rate +3pp triggers rollback.
jon: I'll create the canary flag in Console: pegasus9b.hybrid_gate_canary = {int8:5%, fp16:95%}. Also add paired A/B to track CPA and pass-rate.
ima: Example eval command I used:```bash
ri eval run --model pegasus9b-int8 --suite code-assist-2step --samples 3000 --kv-cache warm --out artifacts/pegasus_int8_code.json
```
rita: Please drop the artifacts and human_notes to drive. I'll run bootstrap tests and prepare GTN blurb with CPA column and recommended default: code-assist endpoints = confidence-gated hybrid, default gate 18%.
ara: Infra note: kernel parity across Dedicated/private may differ. We saw a 3-5% perf delta on older A100 stacks. Need per-cluster profiling before GA.
jon: Noted. Will add per-region perf+quality profile to model catalog entry before we flip defaults.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: pegasus9b-int8-gate-canary will be created by jon on 2026-06-01T11:00:00Z.
rita: Owners: nima -> int6 quick sweep (500 samples) + upload artifacts; jon -> create canary + alerts; ara -> per-region profiling; me (rita) -> bootstrap significance, CPA sims, GTN blurb. Timeline: int6 sweep by EOD, canary early next week.
nima: Will post updates and ping. :thumbsup:
